description: This file contains functions and types related to geometric calculations involving ellipses, including constructing ellipses, checking if points are inside or on the ellipse, calculating distances, and finding intersection points with lines and line segments.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Constructs an Ellipse object with specified center, halfWidth, and halfHeight.

methods.name: ellipseIncludesPoint
methods.description: Checks if a point is inside or on the outline of the ellipse.

methods.name: ellipseTouchesPoint
methods.description: Tests whether a point lies on the outline of the ellipse within a tolerance.

methods.name: ellipseDistanceFromPoint
methods.description: Calculates the shortest Euclidean distance from a point to the ellipse outline.

methods.name: ellipseSegmentInterceptPoints
methods.description: Calculates the maximum of two intercept points for a line segment passing through an ellipse.

methods.name: ellipseLineIntersectionPoints
methods.description: Finds intersection points between an ellipse and a line.
